fleet/apps/zabbix/fleet.yaml:
name: zabbix
defaultNamespace: apps-zabbix

dependsOn:
  - name: longhorn-zabbix-storage

helm:
  chart: zabbix
  repo: https://zabbix-community.github.io/helm-zabbix
  version: 7.1.0
  releaseName: zabbix
  waitForJobs: true
  valuesFiles:
    - values.yaml
fleet/apps/zabbix/values.yaml:
# Match the restored Zabbix 7.4 database schema.
zabbixImageTag: ubuntu-7.4.16

# PostgreSQL data was migrated and recovery-tested on Longhorn (2026-10-25).
# Keep this as an existing claim so Helm/Fleet does not create or delete it.
postgresql:
  enabled: true
  image:
    repository: postgres
    # Preserve the exact PostgreSQL 16.15 image used for the native backup.
    tag: "16@sha256:f1c3376c26f2609ab9f29f71f824103fe2fcd8ee0346485cb6122a4f93df6f94"
  persistence:
    enabled: true
    existingClaimName: zabbix-postgresql-data-longhorn-rwo
    storageSize: 18Gi
  extraRuntimeParameters:
    max_connections: 50

# Keep the restored Zabbix stack running after Fleet reconciliation.
zabbixServer:
  replicaCount: 1

zabbixWeb:
  replicaCount: 1

zabbixWebService:
  replicaCount: 1

ingress:
  enabled: true
  ingressClassName: traefik
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: letsencrypt
    traefik.ingress.kubernetes.io/router.entrypoints: websecure
    traefik.ingress.kubernetes.io/router.tls: "true"
  hosts:
    - host: zabbix.rancher.tailscale.bnowakowski.pl
      paths:
        - path: /
          pathType: Prefix
    - host: zabbix.rancher.localdomain.bnowakowski.pl
      paths:
        - path: /
          pathType: Prefix
  tls:
    - secretName: zabbix-tls-tailscale
      hosts:
        - zabbix.rancher.tailscale.bnowakowski.pl
    - secretName: zabbix-tls-localdomain
      hosts:
        - zabbix.rancher.localdomain.bnowakowski.pl
